column2: The sky is blue because air molecules scatter blue light
column4: Nitrogen and oxygen molecules scatter short-wavelength light in all directions, which makes the sky appear blue.

column2: Seasons change because Earth's axis is tilted
column4: Earth's twenty-three point five degree axial tilt varies each hemisphere's sunlight through the year, causing the seasons.
